placements.domain: Identity, sovereignty, the face you turn to the world.
placements.culturalLine: Semes is the old solar force carried west out of Tyre, the same sun that burned over Phoenicia now standing watch above a new city.
placements.signReading: Identity built for first moves. You reach for what you want before deliberation; the cost is starting things that should have been considered, the gift is acting when others freeze.

placements.signReading: Thought reaches for the principle. You think in arcs and frames; the cost is the detail you needed to honor.

placements.domain: Drawing-toward, the binding of pairs, what you find beautiful.
placements.culturalLine: Astarte, Lady of the Sea, blesses the marriage bed and the war-fleet alike; in Carthage both love and naval power are hers.
placements.signReading: Desire follows the conversation. You are drawn by minds that move; the cost is leaving when the talking stops.

placements.domain: Effort, friction, what you have to push against.
placements.culturalLine: Melqart, champion of the city, burns on his pyre each year and wakes again from the ash; the Greeks saw their Heracles in his labors.
placements.signReading: Your force runs through the other person. You fight by negotiating, and you locate your own position by watching what you refuse. The cost is a fight you can only have with someone else in the room.

placements.domain: Expansion, blessing, what you trust to grow.
placements.culturalLine: Baal Hammon, lord of the Carthaginian sky, presides as father over the gods of the city that Rome would one day learn to fear.
placements.signReading: You are enlarged by the idea you belong to, and the bigger the idea the bigger the return. The cost is a life lived at the scale of the argument instead of the room.

placements.domain: Limit, weight, what asks for endurance.
placements.culturalLine: Baal Hammon, in his eldest aspect, keeps the turning of the agricultural year, the ancient one who must be given everything he is owed.
placements.signReading: Limit is the slowness itself. The body sets the pace and the pace is not negotiable. What survives this is the only thing you will still own in twenty years.

placements.deityEpithet: Lord of the Heavens, first witness named when the city swears
placements.domain: Rupture, sudden change, the pattern broken without warning.

placements.signReading: Rupture enters through the flaw. You find the broken part of the routine and tear out the whole routine to reach it. What you dismantled was still working. What you built instead nobody thought was possible.

placements.deityEpithet: the sea itself, the partner every voyage out of Carthage signs with
placements.domain: Dissolution, longing, the boundary that blurs into the ideal.
placements.culturalLine: Yam is the water under every keel out of Carthage; he carries a fleet to Gades in one season and swallows it whole in the next.
placements.signReading: Dissolution reaches the foundations. The summit keeps receding into fog and you keep climbing toward it. Ambition forgets what it was for. What gets built instead belongs to something larger than the record.

placements.deityEpithet: Death the creditor, in whose ledger every living name is entered
placements.domain: Buried power, forced transformation, what returns changed.
placements.culturalLine: Mot waits at the bottom of the old Phoenician account of the world; the cosmogony has living things first stirring in his mud, and to his keeping every one of them returns.
placements.signReading: Power arrives as the urge to break through. You are rebuilt by the fights you could not walk away from; the cost is the war you started just to feel alive, the gift is the self that survives its own demolition.
